about: The rule that makes the game is in the field and not above it: a cell one origin has claimed is grey, and nothing that origin does alone will close it.
Twenty cells each with one origin, and no look at all, close nothing and cover nothing. Forty looks by another origin close fifteen and cover every cell.
So what an origin is worth is asymmetric — nothing over its own claims, everything over another's — and the referee is the rule itself, which no player can suspend.
